summary: First-principles design review, iteration 7 (full record in review_loop/scrutiny_07.md). Iteration 6 queued two checks: a mocked end-to-end pass through the rewired producers, and SDLG-arm child flow through the new draw accounting. The end-to-end chain is sound (now pinned by tests/test_end_to_end_mocked.py); the SDLG check found the completeness contract still violated at the FORK CREATION step in BOTH treatment arms: _create_lazy_trajectory and _clone_for_sdlg returned None on any exception, so a fork that failed at container/clone/injection vanished from manager.trajectories — hence from total_trajectories, the predictions rows, and the metric-time k — while the vanilla driver records every crashed resample as an empty-patch draw (iteration 6's pro-treatment asymmetry one layer earlier). Worse sub-case: an SDLG alternative that SUBMITS during injection raises Submitted inside the clone step, which the blanket except swallowed — a COMPLETED child with a real, possibly passing patch was silently discarded (data loss AGAINST the treatment) and its container leaked. Companion find (M2): the resample arm's predictions_all_trajectories.jsonl has NO batch delimiters (no primary rows), so iteration 6's parser-side last-batch rule is vacuous there — a shrinking-k re-run left stale surplus runN rows that keep-last-per-tid resurrects into the vanilla arm's k, rarefaction denominator, and diversity pool; unfixable parser-side, fixed at the producer (per-instance row replacement mirroring the primary file's semantics). Truthfulness fix (T3): RESULTS threat 11 cited entailment threshold 0.5 while configs/branching.yaml pre-registers 0.7 (raised pre-pilot to prevent over-merging — which makes the observed all-singleton gate saturation MORE likely); corrected with provenance, direction, and the no-post-hoc-retune rule extended to that knob. All fixed at the producers per the artifacts-truthful-at-source principle: _register_failed_draw (failed-at-creation placeholder draws; Trajectory.agent/env now optional with no-op save/cleanup; containers reaped), _inject_alternative (classifies injection outcome — active / completed-Submitted-with-patch-kept / failed-with-diff-capture), fork index advances on every attempt so a failed draw's id is never overwritten, replace_instance_rows in the resample driver. Spec amendment under ratchet v2 (applied_07_draw_accounting_at_fork.md, channel-1 correction derivable from R4.1/R7.2 symmetric counting): R7.2 gains 'draw accounting starts at the fork decision' plus the producer-side re-run-safety rule for delimiter-less artifacts; tripwire check passes — nothing flips to pass and the bar rises (the treatment now carries its failed fork attempts in its own denominator; a silent treatment-patch-loss channel is closed). One docstring overclaim tightened (mean_pairwise_distance no-rarefaction identity is exact only without empty patches — descriptive metric, full-sample means only). 88 tests pass (was 82; +6 covering every new behavior incl. the queued mocked end-to-end chain and a shrinking-re-run propagation test), py_compile clean, compute_metrics/tau_sweep/budget_audit re-run end-to-end on the real pilot artifacts (tau sweep again shows the disclosed saturation: branch_rate 1.0 below ln5). Because substantive flaws were again found and fixed, gold_standard_met is FALSE per the charter; the loop should pass fresh eyes over the new fork-path code and remaining lifecycle events (trajectory cap, KeyboardInterrupt mid-fork) for any unrecorded asymmetry.

issues_found.title: Fork-creation failures were invisible draws in both treatment arms: _create_lazy_trajectory and _clone_for_sdlg returned None on exception, so failed forks vanished from total_trajectories, the predictions rows, and the metric-time k, while the vanilla driver records every crashed resample as an empty-patch draw
issues_found.rationale: Iteration 6's pro-treatment k-deflation one layer earlier (same M1 mechanism: the treatment is scored at pass@r(r,c) on surviving draws against vanilla's pass@r(k,c_v)). Fixed at the producer: _register_failed_draw registers a failed empty-patch placeholder trajectory; both fork paths rewired; R7.2 amended; stage-tested.

issues_found.title: An SDLG alternative that submits during injection raised Submitted inside _clone_for_sdlg's blanket except: a COMPLETED child with a real, possibly passing patch was silently discarded and its container leaked
issues_found.rationale: Silent data loss AGAINST the treatment plus a resource leak invisible to cleanup_all. _inject_alternative now classifies the injection outcome (active / completed-with-submission / failed-with-diff-capture); the child is registered in every case and reaped when finished; fork index advances on every attempt so a registered draw's id is never overwritten.

issues_found.title: Resample arm's predictions_all_trajectories.jsonl has no batch delimiters, so iteration 6's parser-side last-batch rule cannot isolate a shrinking-k re-run: stale surplus runN rows resurrected into the vanilla arm's metric-time k, rarefaction denominator, and diversity pool
issues_found.rationale: Unfixable at the parsers (no delimiter to split on; synthetic delimiters would change the schema every consumer parses). Fixed at the producer: replace_instance_rows replaces the instance's rows on re-run, mirroring the driver's own primary-file semantics. Tested.

issues_found.title: RESULTS threat 11 misstated the pre-registered entailment threshold as 0.5; the frozen config registers 0.7 (raised pre-pilot to prevent over-merging, which makes all-singleton gate saturation MORE likely)
issues_found.rationale: A methods section quoting the wrong threshold would be a factual error in print, and the raise's direction is material to reading the saturation finding. Corrected with provenance and direction; the no-post-hoc-retune rule now explicitly covers the entailment knob.

issues_found.title: mean_pairwise_distance docstring overclaimed that no rarefaction correction is needed 'by linearity' — exact only when all patches are non-empty (with empties, the expected subset mean is a ratio of random sums)
issues_found.rationale: The code computes full-sample means (no subsetting occurs) and the metric is descriptive-only, so no numeric change; the docstring now states the exactness caveat instead of an overclaim. Adding a correction was rejected as analyst degrees of freedom on a non-confirmatory companion.

changes_made.why: R7.2 — failed forks must be representable in the run record with zero new plumbing (collect_patch_entries, total_trajectories, mismatch warning, cleanup_all all see them).

changes_made.what: New _register_failed_draw (failed placeholder registration + immediate container reaping) and _inject_alternative (classifies injection outcome: active / completed-Submitted-with-patch / failed-with-diff-capture); _create_lazy_trajectory and _clone_for_sdlg rewired to always leave a draw record; _apply_sdlg advances the fork index on every attempt.
changes_made.why: R4.1/R7.2 — draw accounting starts at the fork decision; the Submitted-at-injection child is a completed draw whose patch must be kept; a failed draw's id must never be overwritten by the next cluster.

changes_made.what: New replace_instance_rows; run_temperature replaces an instance's all-trajectories rows on re-run instead of appending.
changes_made.why: R7.2 — the file has no batch delimiters, so producer-side per-instance replacement is the only place a smaller-k re-run's batch boundary is known.
